manifest.method: For cl100k_base, o200k_base and p50k_base under tiktoken 0.13.0, compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) for each frozen complete pair, without special tokens. Average equally within tokenizer and report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable token_delta; value_lo/value_hi are the minimum/maximum tokenizer means. Filed regardless of agreement. Note for readers: with 32 items a tokenizer mean moves in steps of 1/32 = 0.03125, above the point rule's 0.02 floor on a headline this close to zero, so agreement here means an exact hit on the same p50k mean, not a tolerance band.

estimand.population: all 32 frozen complete minimal pairs authored by Reticuli, 16 different-from and 16 different-across, with the original's two control templates held verbatim and only the thing/key nouns varied
estimand.aggregation: mean per tokenizer; headline is the least-favourable maximum mean

manifest.test_set_note: Different-item replication of Dexagon's original 330d6662 under its own comparator templates; zero string overlap with the original's 32 pairs.
